images.name: storm-hawk-bg.png
images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Style/medium: Hand-painted gouache illustration with confident, visible brushstrokes and slightly rough paper grain. Composition borrows from Japanese woodblock prints: bold silhouette, strong diagonal, generous negative space, flat layered planes of color. Limited palette of 5 colors: deep night navy (#0d1530), dusk lavender (#c9c3f0), storm violet (#5a3f8f), warm gold (#f6cf6a), pale mist (#f1f3fb). One clear light source, soft rim light, no lens flare. Shapes are simplified and graphic, not photoreal. Edges are mostly crisp, with a few lost edges where forms meet the sky. Feels like a printed storybook plate, calm but magical.
Avoid: photorealism, 3D render look, glossy plastic shading, airbrushed smooth gradients, over-detailed feathers, HDR glow everywhere, centered symmetrical pose, bokeh, text, letters, logos, frames, borders, watermarks, signatures, extra limbs, warped anatomy.
Asset type: standalone background layer, storm-hawk-bg.png.
Output: PNG, exactly 1280x1024 pixels, 5:4 landscape aspect ratio.
Scene/backdrop: A high cliff-top sky at dusk during a gathering storm. Huge stacked thunderheads drawn as flat, layered woodblock shapes in lavender and violet. A single thin gold lightning fork far in the distance on the right, providing the one light source.
Composition: Lower third: jagged dark navy mountain ridges fading into mist. Upper left is calmer, emptier sky with generous negative space. Flat layered cloud masses and diagonally sloping ridges. Full-bleed artwork without borders.
Constraints: No animals or figures in this image. No hawk. Opaque background.

Asset type: isolated foreground layer, storm-hawk-fg.png.

Subject: A fierce hawk mid-dive along a strong diagonal from upper left to lower right, wings swept back in a sharp crescent, talons forward. Feathers simplified into a few bold painted shapes, with gold catching the leading edge of the wings like rim light from a single off-canvas lightning source on the right. Small crackles of gold static trail off the wingtips. The eye is a single bright gold point.
Composition: The hawk fills about 60% of the frame, cropped slightly by the right edge for energy. Strong asymmetric silhouette, head and talons directed toward lower right, two wings swept back toward upper left. Anatomically coherent single hawk with two wings and two legs.
Constraints: Isolated on a fully transparent background, clean alpha edges, no ground, no sky, no shadow, no backdrop color or paper rectangle. Paper grain and painted texture exist only within the hawk silhouette. Preserve transparency around gold static. Do not paint a checkerboard.
